source_pointers_labels_inputs: every selected window rechecked against immutable source objects
bootstrap_scope: Conditional device-day block bootstrap on these three devices and fixed fitted models; no population inference over unseen hardware.
limitations: Inherited waveform clocks and event-label synchronization are not independently certified.
Cache-block identifiers inferred from relative start resets are not verified acquisition-run identifiers.
The pure-state task excludes transition boundaries and does not measure frame-level transition localization.
There is no physical-fault ground truth; this is state classification, not abnormal-versus-normal detection.
This protocol differs from the earlier two-second raw-waveform pilot; scores are not directly comparable.
